filters.cohort_weighting: Equal total weight per nonempty cost stratum; equal weight per card within each stratum.
filters.cohort_names: aggro/midrange/control are cost-band aliases, not observed opponent archetype frequencies.
filters.reference: Exact original inputs.json.reference, without filtering or renormalization.
filters.resource_within_phase: Existing joint Gold/hand frequencies conditional on nonempty pre-decision hand; no marginal factorization.
filters.hand_interpretation: Hypothetical fixed-slot replacement followed by play removes one card; not the observed distribution conditional on holding any particular candidate.
filters.source_costs_interpretation: Historical abstract 25-cost deck lists; full deck legality was not validated.
filters.statistics_interpretation: Card-pool census and historical resource-only Monte Carlo under a declared policy; not live-match frequencies, win rates, or metagame rates.
filters.uncertainty: Cross-phase observations may share trials; record counts are not independent sample sizes. No price, strength ranking, or sampling confidence interval is assigned here.
filters.replay: Read and validate stored files only; no API calls and no simulation reruns.
